candidate: Company and report year supplied in the frozen query, applied before lexical/dense retrieval and reranking using ReportCorpus.allowed
control: Full-corpus retrieval with the identical CPU models, precision, threads, index and query
generation: Base Qwen3.5-9B via the same vLLM server, 8192 input / 256 output, 5 complete chunks, Unicode JSON, four workers
development_selection: For each scope choose highest labeled development EM, then F1, then supported citations; ties prefer bm25, dense, hybrid, cross_encoder in that order
development_gate: Paired report-cluster EM difference CI95 lower > 0; F1 and supported citation rate non-decrease. Development intervals are exploratory after route selection.
test: Freeze both selected routes before generating test answers; run and independently audit all four modes for both scopes. Report the frozen head-to-head comparison and all negative results.
test_acceptance: Frozen selected candidate must have paired EM CI95 lower > 0, F1 non-decrease and supported citation rate non-decrease; no further tuning from test results
limits: The parent frozen test has already been exposed in earlier research. This is a controlled follow-up, not a newly blind test. Scope filtering uses no page relevance or answer labels. CPU timing is separate from the earlier GPU retrieval timing.
